title: Settings
sub: Manage your account, who sees you, and the e-mail you get.

loadFailed.title: We couldn't load your settings
loadFailed.body: Your details are safe. Try again in a moment.

saveFailed.title: We couldn't save your settings
saveFailed.body: Your choices are still here. Try again in a moment.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.saved: Your privacy settings are updated. Builders see the change right away.

members.title: Signed-in builders
members.text: Anyone with a Banaro account can open your profile.

everyone.title: Everyone
everyone.text: Visitors who aren't signed in can also find you in the directory and open your profile.

precision.legend: What builders see of where you are

neighbourhood.title: My neighbourhood
neighbourhood.text: Builders see your neighbourhood and roughly how far you are, such as 5.8 km, never your street.

city.title: My city only
city.text: Builders see your city and a distance rounded to 5 km, never your neighbourhood.

emailContact.title: Show my e-mail address to builders
emailContact.text: Signed-in builders see it on your profile. Off, Banaro never shows it.

showOnlineStatus.title: Show when I was last online
showOnlineStatus.text: Builders see "Online now" or when you were last seen.

listInAttendees.title: List me as going to events
listInAttendees.text: Builders see your name on the attendee list of events you RSVP to.

blocked.title: Blocked builders
blocked.sub: People you block can't see you or message you, and you won't see them.

none.title: You haven't blocked anyone
none.body: Builders you block appear here, and you can unblock them any time.
